text: up to 80% of HRR did not significantly increase muscle cross-sectional area after 18 weeks of training. These findings suggest that it may be more difficult to promote a hypertrophic effect from ambulatory aerobic exercise, perhaps because such activity is performed more often in daily life. Jubrias and colleagues (47) reported no muscle cross-sectional area changes in elderly men and women following a 24-week stair-climbing and kayaking-type aerobic exercise protocol performed with progressively increased intensity up to 85% of HRR.
